newsitem.title: CHINA: Jiang tells HK China will honour self-rule pledge.
newsitem.headline: Jiang tells HK China will honour self-rule pledge.

text.p: China's President Jiang Zemin reassured Hong Kong residents on Tuesday, the first day under Beijing rule, that a promised high degree of autonomy would be honoured.

"There is no reason to change, the one-country, two-systems, Hong Kong people ruling Hong Kong, the high degree of autonomy...all these will be long-term directions (governing Hong Kong)," Jiang said in a speech during an inauguration ceremony of the new Hong Kong government as part of China.
Jiang reiterated the words of China's late paramount leader about Hong Kong. "Mr Deng Xiaoping said it well. Hong Kong people can rule Hong Kong well. We must have confidence."
Jiang also said that eventually, Taiwan would be reunified with China. "Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan will be reunited together with China," he said, without elaboration.
Portuguese-administered Macau will revert to China in 1999.

Deng, who died early this year, was responsible for the principle of Hong Kong's return to communist-ruled China under a "one country, two systems" formula, allowing the territory to keep its freewheeling capitalist lifestyle for 50 years.
